record.bible_text: And when Saul's<WH07586> son<WH01121> heard<WH08085><WTH8799> that Abner<WH074> was dead<WH04191><WTH8804> in Hebron<WH02275>, his hands<WH03027> were feeble<WH07503><WTH8799>, and all the Israelites<WH03478> were troubled<WH0926><WTH8738>.

And the Beerothites<WH0886> fled<WH01272><WTH8799> to Gittaim<WH01664>, and were sojourners<WH01481><WTH8802> there until this day<WH03117>.)

And Jonathan<WH03083>, Saul's<WH07586> son<WH01121>, had a son<WH01121> <FI>that was<Fi> lame<WH05223> of <FI>his<Fi> feet<WH07272>. And the sons<WH01121> of Rimmon<WH07417> the Beerothite<WH0886>, Rechab<WH07394> and Baanah<WH01196>, went<WH03212><WTH8799>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> about the heat<WH02527> of the day<WH03117> to the house<WH01004> of Ishbosheth<WH0378>, who lay<WH07901><WTH8802> on a bed<WH04904> at noon<WH06672>.

And they came thither<WH0935><WTH8804> into the midst<WH08432> of the house<WH01004>, <FI>as though<Fi> they would have fetched<WH03947><WTH8802> wheat<WH02406>; and they smote<WH05221><WTH8686> him under the fifth<WH02570> <FI>rib<Fi> : and Rechab<WH07394> and Baanah<WH01196> his brother<WH0251> escaped<WH04422><WTH8738>.

For when they came<WH0935><WTH8799> into the house<WH01004>, he lay<WH07901><WTH8802> on his bed<WH04296> in his bedchamber<WH02315><WH04904>, and they smote<WH05221><WTH8686> him, and slew<WH04191><WTH8686> him, and beheaded<WH05493><WTH8686> him, and took<WH03947><WTH8799> his head<WH07218>, and gat them away<WH03212><WTH8799> through<WH01870> the plain<WH06160> all night<WH03915>.

And they brought<WH0935><WTH8686> the head<WH07218> of Ishbosheth<WH0378> unto David<WH01732> to Hebron<WH02275>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428>, Behold the head<WH07218> of Ishbosheth<WH0378> the son<WH01121> of Saul<WH07586> thine enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, which sought<WH01245><WTH8765> thy life<WH05315>; and the LORD<WH03068> hath<WH05414><WTH8799> avenged<WH05360> my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428> this day<WH03117> of Saul<WH07586>, and of his seed<WH02233>.<CM>

And David<WH01732> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> Rechab<WH07394> and Baanah<WH01196> his brother<WH0251>, the sons<WH01121> of Rimmon<WH07417> the Beerothite<WH0886>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto them, <FI>As<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, who hath redeemed<WH06299><WTH8804> my soul<WH05315> out of all adversity<WH06869>,

How much more, when wicked<WH07563> men<WH0582> have slain<WH02026><WTH8804> a righteous<WH06662> person<WH0376> in his own house<WH01004> upon his bed<WH04904>? shall I not therefore now require<WH01245><WTH8762> his blood<WH01818> of your hand<WH03027>, and take you away<WH01197><WTH8765> from the earth<WH0776>?

But they took<WH03947><WTH8804> the head<WH07218> of Ishbosheth<WH0378>, and buried<WH06912><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> in the sepulchre<WH06913> of Abner<WH074> in Hebron<WH02275>.<CM>
